title: Uwell Viscore Pro+ Blue Razz Lemonade Prefilled Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Blue Razz Lemonade Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod combines tangy Blue Raspberry with sparkling Lemonade for a sharp, fruity vape. The tart berry base is lifted by the citrus fizz of Lemonade, creating a lively and refreshing flavour from inhale to exhale. Each pack contains one 2ml Prefilled Pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and one 10ml Refill Pod that automatically replenishes the pod as you vape. Together they deliver up to 20,000 puffs depending on usage, with no messy refills or coil changes required. Using a 0.8ohm mesh coil, the pod produces smooth vapour and crisp flavour throughout. Designed for the Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill into place and you’re ready to vape.
